nodes.name: Copy Trading Strategy.md
nodes.summary: Wiki strategy specification for replicating trades from smart-money sources (notably US Congress politicians), covering target selection, replication logic, latency analysis, and strategy isolation. Defines inputs, outputs, dependencies, and failure modes for the copy-trading approach.

nodes.name: Paper Trading.md
nodes.summary: Wiki documentation of paper (simulated) trading variants used as a validation stage before live deployment, including Alpaca paper accounts, custom-balance accounts, TradingView paper mode, and the Syndicate Squad engine. Specifies promotion criteria from paper to live trading.

nodes.name: Signal Confirmation.md
nodes.summary: Wiki specification of the multi-indicator signal-confirmation pattern that requires agreement across an indicator stack before generating a trade, covering the three-layer equities system, TradingView crypto scalping stack, and safety-filter extension.

nodes.name: VWAP Crossover Strategy.md
nodes.summary: Wiki documentation of the VWAP crossover strategy with concrete long entry and exit rules, validated performance evidence, strategy origin, and failure modes. A focused indicator-based intraday strategy spec.

nodes.name: Wheel Strategy.md
nodes.summary: Wiki specification of the options Wheel Strategy (cash-secured puts then covered calls), detailing the two-stage cycle, hard rules, strike/expiration selection, monitoring schedule, and Claude automation. The most detailed strategy doc in this batch.
